The connector's slice-name owner parse (`slice_name_env_owner`) now accepts both host-hex lengths: the truncated 16-char hex stamped into slice lima names since `mngr_imbue_cloud` shortened them to fit limactl's name budget (long CI env names), and the full 32-char hex on slices baked before the truncation. Reconcile/cleanup keeps attributing every slice to its owning env across the transition.
